purpose: Turn the conceptual T1-T4 dynamic programme into traceable test cases whose numeric acceptance criteria must be controlled before any pass result can close a promotion gate.

testCases.purpose: Characterise free pendulum period, damping, yaw/roll response and repeatability for representative production-intent S/M/L suspended assemblies and shortest/longest line conditions.
Establish response to candidate jerk-limited acceleration/deceleration profiles without using visual animation as dynamic evidence.
prerequisites: candidate motion profile defined as test input

testCases.purpose: Characterise worst credible qualified-stop excitation for an individual long and short suspension assembly.
prerequisites: candidate stop profile mechanically safe on rig
stimulus: power-loss-equivalent stop input where rig supports it

testCases.purpose: Quantify air-drag and ambient-airflow sensitivity for representative suspended assemblies.
stimulus: representative ambient draft/HVAC study where project data exists

testCases.purpose: Measure neighbour interaction and local dynamic clearance in a mixed S/M/L cluster including representative line-length differences.
prerequisites: cluster geometry traces to controlled engineering schedule

testCases.purpose: Develop abnormal-drag/snag detection evidence without damaging production authority geometry.
stimulus: repeatable resisted motion below destructive threshold

testCases.purpose: Check replacement-element mass variation effect on local motion and cluster clearance.
prerequisites: approved replacement sample within measured production variation

testCases.purpose: Validate primary-bearing/support installation quality before full-field dynamics.
Prove that transmission failure does not remove the required carrier holding path.
prerequisites: direct-carrier or equivalent independent holding concept prototyped
stimulus: disconnect or simulate loss of drive transmission

testCases.purpose: Validate primary feedback failure and overspeed/disagreement detection architecture.
stimulus: freeze/plausibly corrupt primary value where test rig permits

testCases.purpose: Validate positive service-lock alignment, full engagement, mis-engagement behaviour and proof load.
prerequisites: prototype service lock and receiver complete

testCases.purpose: Validate representative secondary-retention engagement and common-cause independence before full assembly proof work.
Validate manual recovery so no brake/drive release can create uncontrolled free rotation.
prerequisites: service lock prototype validated for test
stimulus: execute released draft recovery sequence under representative imbalance
attempt prohibited ordering in controlled test

testCases.purpose: Run complete 240-element production-intent field at released minimum, nominal and maximum speeds with controlled start/steady/stop profiles.
prerequisites: full field traceable to engineering schedule
component selections and lower-stage tests sufficiently mature

testCases.purpose: Validate stop, settling and deliberate restart behaviour across representative operating conditions.
prerequisites: full field balanced to controlled procedure
stimulus: reversal study only if separately authorized

testCases.purpose: Validate power-loss, feedback, abnormal-drag and approved fault-stop behaviour on the full production-intent field.
prerequisites: safe full-field fault injection method approved

testCases.purpose: Demonstrate all required dynamic-clearance categories under normal and approved fault transients.
prerequisites: full field and fixed heads/canopy service configuration production-intent

testCases.purpose: Validate factory balance/trim procedure and effect of a representative replacement suspended assembly.
Establish controlled acoustic, vibration and thermal baselines in the production-intent canopy arrangement.
measurements: sound level/spectrum as defined by controlled method

testCases.purpose: Execute the released endurance duty spectrum followed by teardown/inspection sufficient to inform maintenance intervals.
prerequisites: duty spectrum controlled from intended use

testCases.purpose: Demonstrate complete planned service workflow including index, lock, LOTO, representative replacement, balance review and return to service.
stimulus: replace representative kinetic or suspension service item
return to held then run-ready state

stagePromotionRules: Do not mark a test passed until its numeric/qualitative acceptance criteria are controlled before result disposition.
T1 must establish safe single-assembly motion/stop test boundaries before equivalent T2 cluster tests.
T2 local-interaction findings must be dispositioned before T3/T4 geometry or motion conditions repeat the same risk at larger scale.
T3 bearing/drive/brake/lock/retention fault-containment evidence must be sufficient before equivalent full-field T4 fault cases.
T4 requires the exact controlled 240-element schedule and production-intent mechanical configuration; visualization substitutes are prohibited.
Any failed test or unexplained deviation keeps dependent gates false until controlled disposition and re-test are complete.
